goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Approve one substantial text-first vertical slice: a localhost-only web application that lets a non-technical user select a folder in the browser, ingest Markdown/TXT, review/edit/approve/reject cited candidates, persist canonical vault state, and search approved memory with openable source citations. This is large enough to establish the actual product architecture while remaining deterministic, credential-free and reversible. PDF/DOCX extraction and Hindsight projection must use the interfaces established here in later packages; the UI must label them unsupported rather than imply completion.

worker_package.objective: Build the first production-shaped local web vertical slice for Markdown and TXT: a localhost-only server and professional browser UI with directory selection, bounded ingestion, deterministic source-located candidate generation, interactive edit/approve/reject review, canonical vault persistence, approved-memory search with source/line citations, deduplication on repeated ingestion, restart persistence, explicit unsupported PDF/DOCX reporting, recoverable errors, and no remote network calls.
stop_if: Implementation requires writing outside the explicit allowed_files.
The slice would weaken or bypass existing capture, provenance, review, access, secret, or Hindsight governance gates.
Any document content would be transmitted to a non-local endpoint.
Tests require live Hindsight credentials or live network writes.
The implementation cannot keep the default server bound to 127.0.0.1.
The UI would advertise PDF, DOCX, semantic LLM analysis, or Hindsight-backed recall as implemented in this slice.

parallel_safety.reason: The first slice establishes shared server, store, UI and product-test contracts; one bounded Worker avoids cross-cutting conflicts.

missing_evidence: No browser walkthrough exists until the Worker completes the slice.
PDF/DOCX extraction and local Hindsight projection remain explicitly deferred.
Folder deletion reconciliation is not required in this first package unless it falls naturally within the bounded implementation.
required_board_updates: Copy worker_package onto T003 and activate T003.
After T003 verification, perform a browser walkthrough as a phase-boundary review before selecting the PDF/DOCX and Hindsight packages.
